dedupe_keys.name: construction and demolition material infrared and hyperspectral library

description: This material library documents infrared thermography and hyperspectral measurements of construction and demolition waste. Marche Polytechnic University and eCampus University researchers analysed specimens supplied by COMSA and Sorigué sites near Barcelona and Tarragona. The article describes raw spectral cubes, selected-region spectra, visible images, thermal-camera frames and emissivity summaries, with specimen labels and repeated tests. Geographic coverage is the Spanish source sites, with no common acquisition date established here. Zenodo publishes a roughly 96-gigabyte archive free under CC BY 4.0. Laboratory specimens, selected image regions and material mixtures limit direct transfer to moving industrial sorting lines. Modellers could parameterise material-recognition components or compare sorting assumptions in recycling simulations. platform-openlca offers a related environmental-assessment environment, although the measurements require conversion to process inventories. The repository confirms the archive identity; its internal DAT, HDR, CSV and spreadsheet structure comes from the article documentation. No archive, images or numerical measurements were downloaded.
